notes:
Inbound trial signup via self-serve. Product-led SMB using hosted API for chat-based in-app support widget. Early discovery: they hit latency spikes during peak (9am-11am CST) and seeing 500ms -> 1.2s for streaming first-token in na-east-1. Very cost-sensitive — wants to keep per-conversation token cost down; currently using ~1.2k tokens per convo (lots of context).

Call 2026-03-03 with AE + SE + PM: customer demo'd their flow, shared Fireflies recording ff_20260303_8721. Quoted: "experience feels sluggish for users in Europe" — they are routing EU traffic to na-east-1 due to initial signup. Asking for guidance: region choice, timeout best practices, prompt trimming, and streaming config.

Observed: client default http timeout on frontend is 1.5s; they are not using streaming escape hatch (long-poll). Prompt engineering: they include entire user history (20 messages) and full product spec PDF text in every request. Recommended immediate fixes were shared in email thread gmail_thread_9b3f2c_support-prod.

Customer open to simple A/B: region switch + reduce prompt to last 3 messages + add system prompt with short product pointers. Wants to see 200-400ms median first-token in EU and sub-300ms in NA.

Sales note: small ARR, high expansion potential if widget improves UX. Wants SOC2 doc before buying. SE to run perf test and share logs before next call.

requirements_summary: Need hosted API with predictable latency for in-app chat. Primary constraints: low-latency for EU & NA regions, minimal setup (self-serve), SOC2 attestation required for procurement, low cost per conversation. Workload: realtime chat (short to medium sessions), occasional embeddings for doc-search. Willing to accept model fallback to smaller/faster variants during peak if transparent to UX.
latency_targets: EU: median first-token 150-300ms; NA: median first-token <300ms; p95 target <800ms
region_preference: NA primary, EU secondary — willing to deploy EU region but needs guidance on account region settings and DNS/edge routing
prompt_guidance: Reduce context to last 3 user/messages + 1 system instruction. Strip large product spec text from each request; use embeddings retrieval for doc content. Limit system token budget to ~150 tokens and user+history to <800 tokens when possible.
suggestions_provided: try eu-west-1 hosted endpoint for EU traffic
increase client-side http timeout to 5s for streaming handshake
implement prefix caching or short-term KV cache for repeated context
switch to faster model variant (e.g., redwood-mini) as fallback during bursts
